scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --profile release-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p yokohama-wasm --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir src/local/wasm ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release-wasm/yokohama_wasm.wasm && wasm-bindgen --target nodejs --out-dir wasm-node ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release-wasm/yokohama_wasm.wasm && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('wasm-node/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}))" && node scripts/wasm-opt.mjs src/local/wasm/yokohama_wasm_bg.wasm wasm-node/yokohama_wasm_bg.wasm
scripts.build:wasm:debug: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p yokohama-wasm --features debug --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir src/local/wasm ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/yokohama_wasm.wasm
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:client
scripts.build:client: tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/precache.mjs && node scripts/presence.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.sw.json && node scripts/typecheck-worker.mjs
scripts.e2e: npm run build:wasm:debug && node scripts/e2e-build.mjs && playwright test
